notes: Values extracted from kb/load_estimation.py per v0.7 migration.
remains in Python. This JSON is the numeric data layer only.
Parity test verifies JSON == Python constants exactly.

unit_notes.slab_weight: Multiply by slab thickness in mm. 125mm slab = 3.125 kN/sqm
unit_notes.finishes: Typical residential: tiling + flooring + false ceiling
unit_notes.partition: Average allowance for 230mm internal walls over floor

live_loads_by_floor_type.description: Imposed loads per IS 875 Part 2:1987 cl. 4.

concentrated_loads.description: Point / localised loads that ADD to base floor load.
notes: Water tank often missed in amateur design — critical for top-floor
column sizing. 5000L = 5 tonnes = 50 kN over ~4 sqm area.

wall_loads.description: Linear loads from masonry walls on beams/slabs (IS 875 Part 1).

unit_notes.formula: thickness × height × density(≈20 kN/m³) + plaster allowance

partial_safety_factors.description: Partial safety factors for limit state design per IS 456 cl. 36.4.
